english.title: Display threatening / abusive writing / sign / visible representation likely to cause harassment / alarm / distress
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) displayed any writing, sign or other visible representation which was threatening or abusive within the hearing or sight of a person likely to be caused harassment, alarm or distress thereby
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(1) and (6) of the Public Order Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See offence wording H351 for the similar offence under section 4A of intentional harassment/alarm/distress.
(ii) See also offence wording H11412.
(iii) See the CPS charging standards for this offence before preparing any charges.
(iv) This offence is a recordable offence, despite not being an imprisonable offence, see the Schedule to the National Police Records (Recordable Offences) Regulations 2000, therefore actions regarding DNA samples, fingerprints and photographs apply.
(v) From 1st May 2023, this offence is no longer notifiable to the Home Office.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant displayed any writing, sign or other visible representation which was threatening or abusive within the hearing or sight of a person likely to be caused harassment, alarm or distress thereby

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
